import base64, io, warnings
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import HTML, display
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=RuntimeWarning)   # all-NaN bins at masked edges
  • Envelope: built from 9 non-ACCESS CMIP6 historical runs for 1850–1949 (CESM2 ×3, IPSL-CM6A-LR ×3, GFDL-ESM4, MRI-ESM2-0, HadGEM3-GC31-LL).
  • Margin: one number per level and side. Each model in turn is left out, and the margin is how far it falls outside the envelope built from the others.
In [2]:
from pathlib import Path
P2       = Path("..")           # folder holding zonal_ta/ and zonal_test/
ENV_DIR  = P2 / "zonal_ta"       # 9 envelope runs: <label>_ta_185001-194912_zon{max,min}.nc
TEST_DIR = P2 / "zonal_test"     # test datasets:   <LABEL>_ta_185001-194912_zon{max,min}.nc
TESTS    = ["E15H", "E15E"]      # held-out candidates
NAMES = {                      # what the short labels in zonal_test/ stand for
    "E15H": "ACCESS-ESM1-5 historical (CMIP6)",
    "E15E": "ACCESS-ESM1-5 esm-hist (CMIP6)",
    "CM2H": "ACCESS-CM2 historical (CMIP6)",
}
name = lambda lab: NAMES.get(lab, lab)
BIN_DEG  = 2                     # latitude bin width (degrees)
INFO_TOP = 10                    # levels at or above this pressure (hPa) are INFO only
In [3]:
EDGES = np.arange(-90, 90 + BIN_DEG, BIN_DEG)
MID   = (EDGES[:-1] + EDGES[1:]) / 2
NB    = len(MID)
bin_index = lambda lat: np.clip(np.digitize(lat, EDGES) - 1, 0, NB - 1)

def alltime(path, reduce):
    t = xr.open_dataset(path).ta.isel(lon=0)          # zonal files have a single lon
    return t.lat.values, reduce(t.values, axis=0), t.plev.values / 100

def binned(lat, v, reduce):
    out, b = np.full((v.shape[0], NB), np.nan), bin_index(lat)
    for i in range(NB):
        sel = b == i
        if sel.any():
            out[:, i] = reduce(v[:, sel], axis=1)
    return out

Load the 9 envelope runs

In [4]:
files = sorted(ENV_DIR.glob("*_zonmax.nc"))
assert len(files) == 9, f"expected 9 zonmax files in {ENV_DIR.resolve()}, found {len(files)}"
runs, PLEV = {}, None
for fmax in files:
    label = fmax.name.split("_ta_")[0]
    model = label.rsplit("_", 1)[0]
    lat, hi, p = alltime(fmax, np.nanmax)
    _,   lo, _ = alltime(Path(str(fmax).replace("zonmax", "zonmin")), np.nanmin)
    PLEV = p if PLEV is None else PLEV
    assert np.allclose(p, PLEV, rtol=0, atol=1e-3), f"levels differ: {label}"
    runs[label] = dict(model=model, hi=binned(lat, hi, np.nanmax), lo=binned(lat, lo, np.nanmin))
MODELS, NL = sorted({r["model"] for r in runs.values()}), len(PLEV)
print(len(runs), "runs,", len(MODELS), "models,", NL, "levels")
for k, r in runs.items(): print(f"  {k:28s} {r['model']}")

In [5]:
def env_hi(models): return np.nanmax([r["hi"] for r in runs.values() if r["model"] in models], axis=0)
def env_lo(models): return np.nanmin([r["lo"] for r in runs.values() if r["model"] in models], axis=0)
EH, EL = env_hi(MODELS), env_lo(MODELS)

Leave-one-model-out margins

In [6]:
full = np.all([np.isfinite(r["hi"]) for r in runs.values()], axis=0)
MH, ML = np.zeros(NL), np.zeros(NL)
set_by_h, set_by_l = [""] * NL, [""] * NL
for m in MODELS:
    others = [x for x in MODELS if x != m]
    xh = np.where(full, env_hi([m]) - env_hi(others), np.nan)
    xl = np.where(full, env_lo(others) - env_lo([m]), np.nan)
    for k in range(NL):
        if np.nanmax(xh[k]) > MH[k]: MH[k], set_by_h[k] = np.nanmax(xh[k]), f"{m} @ {MID[np.nanargmax(xh[k])]:.0f}"
        if np.nanmax(xl[k]) > ML[k]: ML[k], set_by_l[k] = np.nanmax(xl[k]), f"{m} @ {MID[np.nanargmax(xl[k])]:.0f}"
pd.DataFrame({"hPa": PLEV, "hot margin K": MH.round(1), "set by (hot)": set_by_h,
              "cold margin K": ML.round(1), "set by (cold)": set_by_l}).set_index("hPa").sort_index()   # top of atmosphere first

Test each dataset¶

For each test dataset and level, count the latitudes whose all-time max is above envelope + hot margin, and those whose all-time min is below envelope − cold margin. Also record the largest excess beyond the margin; a negative value means the dataset is inside with that much room to spare.

In [7]:
tests = {}
for lab in TESTS:
    lat, mx, p = alltime(TEST_DIR / f"{lab}_ta_185001-194912_zonmax.nc", np.nanmax)
    _,   mn, _ = alltime(TEST_DIR / f"{lab}_ta_185001-194912_zonmin.nc", np.nanmin)
    assert np.allclose(p, PLEV, rtol=0, atol=1e-3), f"levels differ: {lab}"
    b  = bin_index(lat)
    xh = mx - (EH[:, b] + MH[:, None])        # > 0 means beyond the hot margin
    xl = (EL[:, b] - ML[:, None]) - mn        # > 0 means beyond the cold margin
    tests[lab] = dict(lat=lat, mx=mx, mn=mn, xh=xh, xl=xl,
                      n_hot=(xh > 0).sum(1), n_cold=(xl > 0).sum(1),
                      worst_hot=np.nanmax(xh, 1), worst_cold=np.nanmax(xl, 1))
rows = []
for lab, t in tests.items():
    for k in range(NL):
        rows.append(dict(dataset=lab, hPa=PLEV[k], info=PLEV[k] <= INFO_TOP,
                         hot=int(t["n_hot"][k]), cold=int(t["n_cold"][k]),
                         worst_hot=round(float(t["worst_hot"][k]), 1), worst_cold=round(float(t["worst_cold"][k]), 1)))
RESULTS = pd.DataFrame(rows)
RESULTS["status"] = np.where(RESULTS.hot + RESULTS.cold > 0, "orange", "green")
RESULTS.pivot(index="hPa", columns="dataset", values="status").sort_index()   # 1 hPa at the top, 1000 hPa at the bottom

Plots¶

draw_level draws one level: the envelope in dark grey, the added margin in orange (hot) and light blue (cold), the dataset's all-time max in red and its all-time min in blue, with dots for latitudes beyond the margin. png turns a figure into an inline image, so no files are written.

In [8]:
def draw_level(ax, lab, k, small=False):
    t, info = tests[lab], PLEV[k] <= INFO_TOP
    if info: ax.set_facecolor("0.95")
    ax.fill_between(MID, EH[k], EH[k] + MH[k], color="#f5cba7", lw=0, step="mid")
    ax.fill_between(MID, EL[k] - ML[k], EL[k], color="#aed6f1", lw=0, step="mid")
    ax.fill_between(MID, EL[k], EH[k], color="0.65", lw=0, step="mid")
    ax.plot(t["lat"], t["mx"][k], color="#c0392b", lw=1)
    ax.plot(t["lat"], t["mn"][k], color="#2471a3", lw=1)
    oh, ol = t["xh"][k] > 0, t["xl"][k] > 0
    ax.plot(t["lat"][oh], t["mx"][k][oh], "o", color="#c0392b", ms=3.5)
    ax.plot(t["lat"][ol], t["mn"][k][ol], "o", color="#2471a3", ms=3.5)
    ax.set_xlim(-90, 90); ax.set_xticks(range(-90, 91, 45 if small else 30)); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
    ax.set_title(f"{PLEV[k]:g} hPa{'  (INFO)' if info else ''}  margin +{MH[k]:.1f}/−{ML[k]:.1f} K  out {oh.sum()}/{ol.sum()}",
                 fontsize=9 if small else 11)

def png(fig):
    buf = io.BytesIO(); fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=90, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()

LEGEND = ("dark grey = 9-run envelope;  orange / light blue = added hot / cold margin;  "
          "red / blue = dataset all-time max / min;  dots = beyond margin")
IMG = {}
for lab in tests:
    for k in range(NL):
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5)); draw_level(ax, lab, k)
        ax.set_xlabel("latitude"); ax.set_ylabel("ta (K)"); fig.suptitle(f"{lab} = {name(lab)}\n{LEGEND}", fontsize=8)
        IMG[(lab, k)] = png(fig)
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(4, 5, figsize=(19, 14), sharex=True)
    top_down = list(range(NL))[::-1]          # 1 hPa top-left, 1000 hPa bottom-right
    for i, ax in enumerate(axs.flat):
        if i < NL: draw_level(ax, lab, top_down[i], small=True)
        else: ax.axis("off")
    fig.suptitle(f"{lab} = {name(lab)}, all levels\n{LEGEND}", y=1.0)
    IMG[(lab, "all")] = png(fig)
print(len(IMG), "figures in memory")

def results_html():
    css = '''<style>
    .pv table{border-collapse:collapse;font:13px sans-serif}
    .pv th,.pv td{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:3px 10px;text-align:center}
    .pv td.green{background:#a9dfbf} .pv td.orange{background:#f8c471}
    .pv td.info{font-style:italic;opacity:.75}
    .pv label{cursor:pointer;display:block}
    .pv input{display:none} .pv .fig{display:none;margin-top:10px}
    .pv th label{font-weight:normal;font-size:11px;text-decoration:underline;color:#2471a3}
    '''
    head, body, figs = "<tr><th>hPa</th>", "", ""
    for lab in tests:
        head += f'<th title="{name(lab)}">{lab}<label for="pv-{lab}-all">show all</label></th>'
        css  += f'#pv-{lab}-all:checked ~ #fig-{lab}-all{{display:block}}\n'
        figs += f'<div class="fig" id="fig-{lab}-all"><img src="data:image/png;base64,{IMG[(lab,"all")]}" style="max-width:100%"></div>'
    head += "</tr>"
    for k in reversed(range(NL)):            # top of atmosphere first
        info = PLEV[k] <= INFO_TOP
        body += f"<tr><th>{PLEV[k]:g}{' INFO' if info else ''}</th>"
        for lab, t in tests.items():
            h, c = int(t["n_hot"][k]), int(t["n_cold"][k])
            cls = ("orange" if h + c else "green") + (" info" if info else "")
            tip = f"worst beyond margin: hot {t['worst_hot'][k]:.1f} K, cold {t['worst_cold'][k]:.1f} K"
            body += f'<td class="{cls}" title="{tip}"><label for="pv-{lab}-{k}">{h}/{c}</label></td>'
            css  += f'#pv-{lab}-{k}:checked ~ #fig-{lab}-{k}{{display:block}}\n'
            figs += f'<div class="fig" id="fig-{lab}-{k}"><img src="data:image/png;base64,{IMG[(lab,k)]}" style="max-width:100%"></div>'
        body += "</tr>"
    key = "<p style='font:12px sans-serif'>" + "<br>".join(f"<b>{lab}</b> = {name(lab)}" for lab in tests) + "</p>"
    radios = "".join(f'<input type="radio" name="pv" id="pv-{lab}-{k}">' for lab in tests for k in list(range(NL)) + ["all"])
    return f'<div class="pv">{css}</style><table>{head}{body}</table>{key}{radios}{figs}</div>'

display(HTML(results_html()))
